thread:
maria: Quick sanity check — ran a fast quant sweep on nova11b-int6 yesterday, need a short recommendation for product (cost vs quality). summary below.
noah: drop the summary pls (1-2 lines) and the main nudge you want for GTN.
sasha: TL;DR first: int6 is ~2.8x cheaper per-token vs fp16, quality drop ~2-3% on small chat evals, latency +8ms p50.
maria: thanks. details: eval sample = 4000 chat turns, mixed instr/long-context, prefix perf caching on. key metrics: p50 latency 86ms (fp16 78ms), p95 230ms (fp16 205ms), token cost est $0.0009/token (fp16 $0.0025/token). quality: sacreBLEU-like proxy drop 2.4 points, LLM-score delta -0.03.
eli: what's the variance across slices? any big regressions on code/recall?
maria: slice breakdown: instruction-following -1.8% quality, long-context summarization -3.9% (worst), code generation -0.8%.
noah: suggestion: keep int6 as optional routing for low-Latency short-chat reads, not for long-context summarization. offer canary to 10% traffic with routing rule: if tokens > 1024 -> prefer fp16.
sasha: agree. also recommend hybrid decode: int6 for prompt tokens + fp16 for generation when generation length > 256.
eli: can we do dynamic quant fallback? if generation token delta probability < 0.2 -> fallback to fp16.
maria: For product brief: "Recommend enabling int6 for chat L0 (short-turns). Block for summarize-heavy endpoints; run a focused eval on summarization with 10k samples." simple ask.
eval-bot: PERF REPORT: nova11b-int6 | cost_factor=0.36 | p50_ms=86 | p95_ms=230 | quality_score=0.966 | fp16_quality=0.996
noah: add operational notes: KV cache size unchanged, memory headroom ~+12% so can run slightly larger batch. quant bringup checklist: monitoring on quality-signal, auto-fallback on regression >1.5%.
sasha: Quick prompt engineering idea: soft-prompt guide that steers summarization toward precision (reduce hallucination) — try a 3-sample prompt set and re-eval.
maria: OK I'll draft a one-pager for GTN: 1) metrics snapshot 2) recommended routing flags (int6 default for short_chat, prefer fp16 for summarize endpoints) 3) canary plan (10% traffic, 48h, regression thresholds) 4) follow-up eval request (10k summarization slice).
eli: add cost estimate for product: projected monthly token mix 60% short_chat, 30% summarize, 10% longform. if enable int6 for short_chat -> blended unit cost drops ~28%.
noah: code snippet for routing policy to include in brief:
```
route_rule {
  name: "short_chat_int6"
  condition: "request.tokens.total <= 128 and endpoint != 'summarize'"
  model_preference: ["nova11b-int6", "nova11b-fp16"]
  canary: 0.10
}
```
maria: perfect. will attach the eval-bot csv and the brief. anyone want to add objections?
eli: one caveat: we don't have long-term retention evals on user prompts; recommend collecting production-shared prompt sample for 2 weeks before full rollout.
sasha: +1 to that. we should also instrument hallucination rate specifically for summarization.
maria: noted. I'll post the one-pager in #eng-ml when ready and ping GTN channel for prioritization. thanks all :thumbsup:
